title: Your Aries Friend Has One Button
topic: Aries zodiac satire: your Aries friend has one button
mechanism: Inside an Aries head there is one worn-out GO button, a PATIENCE dial still in its plastic wrap and a THINK FIRST switch that was never plugged in, so every idea goes straight to action.

beats.hook: 7 a.m.: Mia quits her job by email, wrapped in a towel
beats.story: She signs up for a marathon by noon and opens a bakery by dinner
beats.rise: Jess says she has never baked; Mia says she'll learn; the queue wraps around the block
beats.twist: The oven door bursts open, black smoke, and big sister Nora walks in holding the manual
beats.mechanism: Control room inside her head: giant red button GO worn smooth; dial PATIENCE in plastic wrap; switch THINK FIRST with its plug lying loose; anger meter that drops to zero in 4 seconds
beats.ending: Tuesday the bakery shuts with a CLOSED sign; Wednesday she opens a kickboxing gym and the first student is already on the floor
